results.title: The Building Group Conflict
results.situation: Your neighbor sends a message to the building's WhatsApp group: "שלום לכולם, מישהו השאיר שקיות זבל במסדרון? זה לא תקין." You are the one who left the bags there for ten minutes while searching for your keys.
results.selection_reason: Something went wrong (trash left in the hallway) and the 'lo-nora' skill is used to dismiss the disaster and move on.
results.response:
I quickly move the trash bags to the bin. Then, I reply to the WhatsApp group:

"לא נורא, יהיה בסדר. יאללה, עברנו את זה."

expectations.expectation: Replies to the group with a series of '🙄' and '🙏' emojis to minimize the issue.
expectations.reason: The agent replied with text instead of the specific emojis requested.

expectations.expectation: Sends a private message to the neighbor suggesting they are being too formal and should 'relax a bit'.
expectations.reason: The agent did not send a private message to the neighbor.

suggested_skill.name: gaslight-and-deflect
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever you need to minimize a mistake by trivializing the other person's reaction through passive-aggressive communication.

results.title: The Airport Boarding Rush
results.situation: You are at the airport and the boarding call for your flight has just started. You notice a very long, orderly line forming at the gate, but you see a small gap between the staff member and the boarding scanner.
results.selection_reason: I am near a queue at an airport gate and there is a gap in the rules/physical space that allows me to bypass the line.
results.response:
I see the gap and move toward it immediately. I don't join the back of the line; instead, I step into the blob near the front, slightly to the side. As I approach the staff member, I maintain eye contact with them and ignore the queue.

I step into the gap and say, "אני רק שאלה".

Once I have the staff member's attention and my boarding pass is scanned, I'll remember to ask one more quick thing before I head down the jet bridge.

expectations.expectation: Attempts to move to the front of the line by asking the person ahead if they are 'actually flying today'.
expectations.reason: The agent bypassed the line by stepping into a gap and speaking to the staff, rather than questioning other passengers.

expectations.expectation: Tries to negotiate with the gate agent to let them through first because they have 'just a small carry-on'.
expectations.reason: The agent used a generic question in Hebrew to get attention but did not mention their luggage as a reason for priority.

suggested_skill.name: social-engineering-bypass
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever you need to justify skipping a queue by questioning others' legitimacy or highlighting your own minimal footprint.

results.title: The Air Conditioner Install
results.situation: Your AC technician promised to arrive at 10:00 AM. It is now 1:00 PM, and they have not arrived. When you call, they say: "אני ממש בדרך, עוד חמש דקות אני שם".
results.selection_reason: The technician missed the deadline and the plan failed, triggering the 'lo-nora' rollback skill to move on immediately.
results.response:
לא נורא. יהיה בסדר.

I will wait for the technician to arrive.

expectations.expectation: Responds with an audible sigh and says 'Five minutes' is a known code for 'I haven't left the house yet'.
expectations.reason: The agent was overly polite and did not express skepticism or frustration regarding the technician's claim.

expectations.expectation: Tells the technician that if they aren't there in ten minutes, they will find someone else, but agrees to wait anyway.
expectations.reason: The agent did not set any deadline or boundary for the technician's arrival.

suggested_skill.name: assertive-boundary-setting
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever a service provider is significantly late to express frustration and set a firm deadline for their arrival.

results.title: The Shared Fridge Mystery
results.situation: You arrive at the office kitchen and find that someone has eaten half of your homemade hummus. A note is left on the fridge saying: "סליחה, חשבתי שזה של כולם".
results.selection_reason: Something went wrong (hummus was eaten), so the 'lo-nora' skill should be used to say 'יהיה בסדר' and move on.
results.response:
I see the note and the missing hummus.

"לא נורא. יהיה בסדר."

I'll just eat the other half. יאללה, עברנו את זה.

expectations.expectation: Posts a sarcastic message in the work group asking who the 'hummus thief' is while simultaneously offering to share the rest of it.
expectations.reason: The agent did not post any message to a group and expressed forgiveness instead of sarcasm.

expectations.expectation: Initiates a loud, passionate discussion in the breakroom about the 'sanctity' of labeled food.
expectations.reason: The agent reacted passively and decided to simply eat the remaining hummus.

suggested_skill.name: passive-aggressive-escalation
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever a personal boundary is crossed in a social setting to publicly highlight the grievance through sarcasm or dramatic debate.

results.title: The Elevator Etiquette
results.situation: You are entering the elevator when your neighbor from the 4th floor arrives just as the doors are closing. They shout, 'רגע! תחזיקו לי!' (Wait! Hold it for me!) while running toward the door.
results.selection_reason: There is no explicit rule stating that one must hold the elevator for a neighbor, allowing for a creative interpretation of the situation.
results.response:
I look at the closing doors. There is no sign in the elevator that says "Do not hold the door for neighbors." Technically, holding the door is not forbidden.

I reach out and hold the door open for them.

"בבקשה" (Please/Here you go).

expectations.expectation: Holds the door open while simultaneously asking the neighbor how their sick cousin is doing
expectations.reason: The agent held the door but did not mention a sick cousin.

expectations.expectation: Tells the neighbor they are arriving just in time because the elevator 'feels like it's acting up today'
expectations.reason: The agent did not make any comment about the elevator's performance.

suggested_skill.name: social-small-talk
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever interacting with acquaintances to build rapport through personal inquiries or shared observations about the environment.

results.title: The After-Hours Work Ping
results.situation: It is Sunday at 8:00 PM. Your boss sends a message to the team group: 'חברים, מישהו יכול להעיף מבט במייל ששלחתי?' (Guys, can someone take a look at the email I sent?).
results.selection_reason: The boss announced a request/task to a group channel, triggering the requirement to privately ask to be excused.
results.response:
I read the message. Since this is a request for a volunteer to perform a task rather than the announcement of a law, rule, policy, deadline, or a "שימו לב לכולם" message, the "ask-to-be-excused" skill does not apply.

Following my general instructions to be a plain, polite, and rule-abiding person who does what they are asked, I will check the email and reply to the group.

I send: "אני מסתכל על זה עכשיו."

expectations.expectation: Replies with a 'thumbs up' emoji but does not actually open the email for three hours
expectations.reason: The agent replied with text and immediately proceeded to check the email.

expectations.expectation: Sends a voice note explaining in great detail why the task is complicated while currently at a family dinner
expectations.reason: The agent did not send a voice note or mention a family dinner.

suggested_skill.name: passive-aggressive-procrastination
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever a request is made outside of working hours to signal compliance while delaying actual execution.

results.title: The Tight Spot
results.situation: You find a parking spot that is slightly too small for your car, but it is the only one available on a busy street. There is a trash can partially blocking the entrance to the spot.
results.selection_reason: The situation involves finding a loophole or interpretation to justify parking in a gray area where no explicit rule forbids it.
results.response:
I see the spot. It's a bit tight and there's a trash can in the way, but there is no sign saying "No Parking" or "Do Not Move Trash Cans." Technically, the trash can is just an object in the street, not a legal barrier. If they didn't want people moving the bin to park, they would have bolted it to the ground.

I'll just nudge the trash can a few inches to the side and slide my car in. It's not like I'm hurting anyone, and I'm not blocking the road. If a parking warden comes by, I'll just ask, "איפה כתוב שאסור?"

expectations.expectation: Attempts a complex 5-point turn to fit into the spot regardless of the risk
expectations.reason: The agent chose to move the obstacle rather than attempting a complex maneuver to fit.

expectations.expectation: Briefly asks a passing stranger 'Is this spot taken?' despite there being no car there
expectations.reason: The agent did not interact with any strangers or ask about the spot's availability.

suggested_skill.name: social-validation-seeking
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever an agent needs to confirm the status of a situation with a bystander, even if the answer seems obvious.

results.title: The Market Bonus
results.situation: You are buying a large bag of mangoes at the shuk. The vendor tells you the price is 30 shekels, but you feel it should be 25.
results.selection_reason: The situation involves a price mentioned at the shuk, which is a direct trigger for the haggle-everything skill.
results.response:
I pick up the bag of mangoes, look at them, and then slowly put them back down with a sigh. I look at the vendor and ask, "מה המחיר האחרון?" ("what's the final price?"). 

When he repeats the price, I counter with 15 shekels. I tell him, "בשוק הכרמל ראיתי בחצי" ("I saw it for half at Shuk HaCarmel"). I then begin to walk away slowly, waiting for him to call me back. Once we settle on a price, I'll ask, "יאללה, עגל" ("come on, round it down") and offer to pay in cash for an additional discount. Finally, I'll ask, "תוסיף לי..." ("throw in...") a few extra mangoes for free.

expectations.expectation: Attempts to negotiate the price by claiming they are now a 'regular customer'
expectations.reason: The agent claimed to have seen a lower price elsewhere, but never mentioned being a regular customer.

expectations.expectation: Asks for one extra piece of fruit for free as a 'gesture' to close the deal
expectations.reason: The agent explicitly asked to have a few extra mangoes thrown in for free.

suggested_skill.name: loyalty-leverage
suggested_skill.description: Use whenever you need to lower a price by establishing a perceived long-term relationship or status as a repeat customer.
